# Dealers 1st

> Dealers 1st provides remote BDC, sales, finance and F&I support to independent used-car dealerships across the United States.

Dealers 1st works as an extension of an independent dealership's team — not software, not consulting — helping dealerships keep leads, appointments, and finance workflows moving.

## Services
- BDC / Lead Management: internet lead response, calls, text/email follow-up, missed-call recovery, appointment scheduling and confirmation, aged-lead reactivation, CRM tracking.
- Sales Support: customer follow-up, lead nurturing, appointment support, pipeline management, missed-opportunity recovery.
- Finance & F&I Support: credit application workflow, lender communication, approval/status tracking, F&I workflow support.
